title: channels__send — output
description: Output schema for the channels__send MCP tool. Returned as soon as the message is durably accepted by the backing store. Defined in CONTRACTS.md §5.1.

sent_at.description: Unix epoch seconds (floating point) at which the backing store accepted the message. This is the canonical sent_at timestamp echoed back in recv output.

message_id.description: Backing-store-assigned unique identifier for the message just sent.
